corpus_wide_validator_recommendations.scope: Apply every detector to every nonempty visible_content_copy before any variant-specific allowlist. Variant IDs may narrow a legitimate product-noun exception, never the detector itself.
neutral_counterexamples: The import did not finish. Existing saved items remain unchanged.
Undo is unavailable here. The reason is shown.
Continuity is off. Saved information remains on this device.
Search has no results for the current words. Saved items are unchanged.
The Goal Path route is visible. The selected Goal remains unchanged.
No Events are scheduled for this day.
required_negative_tests: Reject each banned term in both phrase orders and in every variant ID, including IDs outside reviewed fixtures.
Reject action imperatives after sentence starts, semicolons, colons, and em dashes.
Reject command promises and action-effect claims in every gap-blocked record.
Permit supported product nouns such as Goal Path route and Event only when their linked requirements authorize the concept.
Assert the live residual docket is empty after repair and bind that assertion to the full 433-record corpus.
